title: Cancel a general boat driving licence
summary: You can cancel your general boat driving licence by visiting a service centre or by mailing in a request.
intro: If you want to cancel your general boat driving licence, you can do this at a service centre, or post your request to the Service NSW Agency Business Centre.
what_you_need: Your current general boat driving licence (if available)
A written request to cancel your licence

how_to_steps.text: Complete the Request for Refund (Maritime) – PDF (if applicable).
Make sure that you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person, or post it to:Service NSWAgency Business CentrePO Box 21Parkes NSW 2870

faqs.q: How can I cancel my general boat driving licence?
faqs.a: You can cancel your licence by visiting a service centre or by posting your request to the Service NSW Agency Business Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to cancel my licence?
faqs.a: You need your current general boat driving licence (if available), a written request to cancel, the 'Request For Refund Form' (if applicable), and your proof of identity.
